item.description:
Draft and Prompt are about ten times quicker. The instruction sheet each mode works from used to be re-read on every dictation, and that was most of the wait. It is now read once and kept: a Prompt rewrite comes back in a fraction of a second, a Draft in about half a second — the same words, verified against the old path.

The first dictation after the model loads still pays for that reading once, mostly while you are speaking.
